physics_and_domain.mesh: Opt-in standalone NestedMesh levels0-3, original seed triangles split4x per level. CPU Brent-projected new Roche vertices, original topological seam identities, four-quarter symmetry, closed edges/Euler2 and root-face ancestry. No selective adaptation, field interpolation or physical prediction cache.
physics_and_domain.bounds: At most40000faces/component, at most128snapshotphases; existing circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating q[.5,2]/spin[.5,1.5]/inner-radius[1e-6,.25] and thermal/radiance/reflection bounds. Fresh per-candidate state/temperature/LD/coverage are rebuilt.
physics_and_domain.correction: Original scalar mesh correction at seed_degree/2**level applied to the new topology. This is an explicit finite numerical convention, not an established truncation-error calibration for this mesh.
physics_and_domain.bridge: CPU initial mesh, midpoint Brent roots, orientation/hulls/eclipse coverage and extra per-face host grouping; device corrected state, tiled full-donor irradiation, integration and fresh BB radiance. CK04 uses explicit originalCPU radiance/LD. Hybrid, not all-GPU.
physics_and_domain.independent_reference: OriginalCPU state/gravity/temperature/reflection primitives and unchanged Observer/router, with independently tiled NumPy/Numba reflection. Moved into experimental.gpu_reference with compatibility script exports. Level0 comparisons use unmodified denseCPU; previous dense controls through2deg remain covered by full hardware suite.
physics_and_domain.unsupported: New standalone nested experiment raises UnsupportedNestedMeshError rather than silently replacing requested refined numerics with a coarse prediction. Existing CPU/default and hybrid fallback behavior remains unchanged. Accuracy errors stay outside candidate penalties; no new public fitting backend.

error_contract.finite_enclosure: Actual signed root-group changes plus third-light normalization change and summation/normalization residual reconstruct the computed prediction change. Sum of absolute component changes, constants/residual and a host arithmetic guard encloses that finite change. Root-face L1 envelope/local scores remain separate conservative localization diagnostics.
error_contract.budget: Nominal-sigma component envelope jointD<=0.1; independent of fittedln_f. Regression checks prove nuisance inflation cannot evade require_budget. This gate has no interpretation as an uncomputed/continuum bound.
error_contract.likelihood: Original observational sigma²*(1+exp(2ln_f)), reducers/order/repeats/mean, original physical prior. For fixed candidate/prior, |delta logL| <= sum(|r|E+E²/2), retaining the actual data residual cross term. Finite prediction-change enclosure only.
error_contract.snapshot: Immutable output arrays/mappings; physical/seed/source/passband/settings identity prevents comparing stale candidates or response tables. Caller-supplied fixed scientific asset revision independently checked by worker manifest.
error_contract.localization: Noise-weighted root-group scores/top10 and L1 contributions from partially clipped faces and limb-straddling root groups. RootL1 overestimates strongly because of intra-component cancellation. Masks are diagnostic, not acceptance filters.
error_contract.not_certified: No continuum error bound, assumed convergence order, monotonicity, Richardson extrapolation, finite-exposure treatment or astrophysical-systematic calibration. Native1.5deg cross-check is a different finite triangulation, not exact truth or an implementation oracle.

scientific_assessment.cases: Reflected partial/totalBB and partialCK04/tableLD, both eclipses, contact-focused support57/69/57phases with ordering/repeats/phase shift/third light, V and bolometric; explicit paired12deg seeds, levels0-3.
scientific_assessment.physical_observations: Two fresh phase proposals and one JD proposal, original serializer/time-layer/prior/thirdlight/mean/noise and original likelihood. Shape and nuisance parameters change; both nested levels freshly rebuilt. Out-of-prior control remains original -inf without nested evaluation. IndependentCPU prediction/density comparison and measured data-dependent likelihood-error bounds.
scientific_assessment.accuracy: Last nested pairs and independently triangulated1.5deg comparisons still exceed the0.1 budget. The estimator exposes this; same-grid CPU/GPU agreement cannot repair shared numerical surface error. Neither finest mesh is treated as truth.
scientific_assessment.fitting_and_mcmc: Standalone preflight/likelihood study, not a new optimized physical fit or sampler. Existing full-suite public fit and sampler-equivalence controls revalidated; no new mixing, convergence, ESS/sec or continuum posterior claim.
scientific_assessment.remaining: Use validated local indicators to design and independently validate selective surface/contact quadrature or a surface correction/error model; qualify fixed numerical protocol over physical parameter domain before finer fits/chains.

timing_conditions.matched: Same bounded unit, affinity0-15/Nice10, threads1, FP64; explicit JAX CPU and GPU backends, identical complete host snapshot/density outputs. Equal output contracts only.
timing_conditions.snapshot: Timers include full fresh curve, CPU projection/rootfinding/state/bridges, irradiation/radiance/coverage, all per-call transfers and extra CPU parent grouping. Constructors outside rowtimers, inside driverwall. Device selection/initialization may occur in constructors. First calls include compilation incurred; repeated shapes across rows may reuse process kernels. Single observations, not throughput distributions.
timing_conditions.reference: IndependentCPU curve/density timers return smaller output than snapshots; never use these as matched snapshot speedup baselines. Withheld originalCPU cross-grid construction, parity/error reports, conversions and shared setup included in full driverwall.
timing_conditions.budget_preflight: Compare_surfaces/require_budget cost follows snapshot modeltimers and is inside driver main wall. Full new numerical preflight requires both coarse and fine snapshot costs plus comparison, not just the finest modeltime. Driver main wall starts after imports; profile_command_wall_seconds additionally includes Python/import startup. Each allocation also includes separate GPU device probe and safety overhead.
timing_conditions.development: CPU-only development profiles on cores16-19/Nice19 while production runs excluded from matched timing evidence.
